# requirements.lock.txt — the PINNED frontend dependency set (audit E83).
#
# Deploy installs THIS file (orwell-install.sh / orwell-update.sh fall back to
# requirements.txt only when it is absent), so every box runs exactly what was
# tested — never a blind re-resolution of unpinned ranges on update.

# Regenerate (pins must install on the Debian 13 deploy target, Python 3.13.5; ci/prod_python_version):
#   pip install pip-tools
#   pip-compile --no-header --output-file requirements.lock.txt requirements.txt
